title: License existing digital artifacts as commercial kits
hypothesis: Existing diagrams, templates, specifications and automation artifacts can be packaged and licensed as useful operator kits rather than remaining internal documentation.
buyer: AI builders, operators and small businesses
offer: One-off commercial kit containing a focused artifact bundle and usage instructions.
smallest_test: Select one artifact bundle, write a one-page buyer-facing description, and test it with 10 qualified prospects.
